current.text: Recent news says he is fully ready for the start of the season, and he appears healthy.
One expert is still very worried that he gets hurt again.
Joe projects him as the starting center for Memphis.

Joe expects limited minutes, about 25 to 28 a night, to manage his large frame. Isaiah Stewart and Quinten Post would take the extra center minutes. Coach Tuomas Iisalo uses short stints, keeps minutes down and runs an 11-man rotation.
A newer note says he might play more minutes in his third season.
Joe expects about 65 games, partly because Edey is thinking about his contract extension.

Experts see him as clearly undervalued. Josh calls him a top 60 player at worst and says to take him in the 70s rather than wait for his ESPN ADP of 124. Others see a value gap of 20 to 50 spots and low downside even if he misses time.
If healthy he would be a top 50 player, and top 40 if he played 30 minutes. At 30 minutes he would be the best fantasy player in his draft class.
In a mock auction he went for 20 USD, more than Franz Wagner or Jaren Jackson.
Josh would pay up to 11 USD for him in an auction.
Memphis plays at a very high pace, which helps his counting stats.

durable.text: He has had multiple ankle and foot surgeries, with three significant ankle or foot problems in his first two seasons.
His repeated ankle problems make health the main concern. He is moving toward Kawhi and Embiid territory but is not there yet.
When on the court he is one of the most efficient and dominant players in the NBA, though the sample is small.
His category strengths are FG% on good volume, rebounds and blocks. All three are league outliers. He converted 50% of rim contests into blocks in a small sample.
His FT% is good for a center, so he does not drag FT% down like many big men.
He makes almost no threes and has high turnovers for a center.

note: Edey went for just 2 USD in our league last season, and ESPN values him at 2 USD. Yahoo values him at 15 USD (average cost 7.2 USD). Experts call him top 60 at worst, and Josh would pay up to 11 USD, so a bid of about 8 to 12 USD looks fair. Avoid the 20 USD that he went for in a mock. He gives elite FG%, rebounds and blocks with few threes and high turnovers, so he fits punt TO and big-man builds. Early in the season, check that his Yahoo ankle Q status clears and that his minutes really sit near 25 to 28.
